recipe.visualDefinition: A central circular graphic resembling a stylized steering wheel or hubcap, divided into four quadrants containing distinct photographic vignettes of a car and its owners, set against a solid dark background with bold, high-contrast typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular frame acting as a container for multiple photographic perspectives
High-contrast relationship between the bright yellow title and black background
Symmetry between the four quadrants radiating from a central hubcap detail
Color coordination between the red jackets of the subjects and the red automotive accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The circular collage dominates the center and lower two-thirds of the frame; the band and car details are scaled to fit within the quadrants.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central chrome hubcap detail serves as the geometric and visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large yellow title, move to the band name, then spiral through the four quadrants starting from the top group photo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the top and corners focuses attention on the central graphic.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black provides a deep, non-reflective background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Sage green defines the geometric structure of the collage.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the primary title; vibrant red in the photography for pop.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, high-saturation text against low-value background; photography uses naturalistic but punchy 60s film tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to one primary accent color for text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, wide sans-serif and condensed italic sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses ultra-heavy weight with minimal tracking
Secondary text uses high-slant italics with tight spacing
All caps for primary and secondary emphasis
characterSpecificRedesigns: Periods in the acronym are square and thick
Italic 'A' in secondary text has a sharp apex
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy, wide yellow blocks and lean, slanted white lines.
graphicDevices: Circular frame with four trapezoidal cutouts
Thin horizontal rule at bottom right

preserve: Heavy weight of the main title
Italic slant of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the visual weight and blocky nature of the main title.
Captures the lean, aggressive slant of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1960s style collage. The background is solid black. In the center is a large sage-green circle. Inside the circle are four quadrants separated by the green frame. The top quadrant shows four men in red jackets leaning on a classic car. The bottom quadrant shows a chrome car emblem. The left and right quadrants show close-ups of car grills and taillights. In the very center is a chrome hubcap.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the top left corner using an extra-bold, wide yellow sans-serif font. Add the secondary text to the right of the title in a white, condensed, italic sans-serif font. Add a small logo and thin line in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main title yellow and extra-bold?
Are there four distinct photo quadrants inside a green circle?
Is the secondary text slanted and white?

mustRedesign: Specific faces of the people in the photo

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the graphic frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the green circle is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the yellow text does not touch the green circle.
Verify the four quadrants are symmetrical.
Confirm the hubcap is the central focal point of the circle.
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric circular frame + 4-quadrant photography + bold bi-color header typography + solid dark background.
